messages:
erin: FYI noticed clients seeing duplicate SSE payloads after a routing rebalance at ~11:02 UTC. small sample below.
sam: are these billing duplicates or just repeated chunks?
erin: both. trace snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-05-05T11:02:03Z session=svc-91 conn=sse-14 proxy=edge-03 event=forced_close reason=rebalance
2026-05-05T11:02:03Z session=svc-91 reconnect token=rt:zz9 seq=512 resume_nonce=7
2026-05-05T11:02:03Z billing check=miss charge_id=chg_77 dup=false
```
erin: note resume_nonce present, but our dedupe still missed because route_id changed and we only dedupe by (session, route, token).
zack: hmm. resume_nonce was added for idempotency but billing still ignores it. why?
sam: billing pipeline only validates token signature and (session, route, token). resume_nonce not surfaced in billing ingest due to backward compat.
priya: two paths: 1) teach billing to accept signed resume_nonce as part of dedupe key, 2) maintain short-lived shared dedupe kvcache across pools for (session, seq)->charge.
erz: (typo) sorry `erin` meant to say 2) is easiest to roll out quickly.
zack: kvcache adds RPCs but minimal memory if we cap TTL to 30s and shard by tenant.
sam: another thought: make resume_token carry an opaque signed origin_hint (edge_id+epoch) not raw internal ids. billing can validate signature and use it as fallback dedupe key. less state but needs token format change.
priya: console UX: SREs currently see "reconnects" spike. we should show an explicit marker in request timeline for "evicted/rebalanced" and a small per-tenant metric `resume.dupe_rate`. makes oncall triage faster.
erin: agree. propose emitting `edge.rebalance.v1 {session, orig_route, new_route, resume_nonce, reason}` as a lightweight trace event. console can index and annotate.
zack: rollout plan: 1) emit rebalance telemetry (no billing change) for 48h, 2) enable kvcache dedupe behind flag `billing.kv_resume_dedupe_v1` at 5% canary, 3) if metrics look good, expand.
sam: short-term hotfix: widen server-side dedupe window by 1.5s for resumes that follow a rebalance event. quick mitigation.
priya: also add alert in console when `resume.dupe_rate` > 0.2% over 10m, with link to query that shows `edge.rebalance.v1` events.
ops-bot: created INF-7123 to track telemetry + billing + console work and linked this thread.
erin: I'll open the PR for emitting `edge.rebalance.v1` and a query sample for dedupe misses.
zack: billing will prototype kvcache dedupe this sprint. will post ETA in INF-7123.
sam: assign owners: erin (edge telemetry), zack (billing kvcache), priya (console panels & alerts).
priya: will mock panel and add tooltip: "Evicted/rebalanced -> possible duplicate charge". small panel under tenant overview.
ops-bot: rolled back the aggressive rebalance tweak in eu-west canary at 11:30 UTC while we triage.
erin: thanks. follow-ups in INF-7123. :thumbsup:
